title: QSM-FAI Escalation Outbox Entry Schema
description: A standing, queryable record of an unresolved escalation awaiting steward attention. MAY be implemented as a materialized view over TENURE Records filtered to entry_type: escalation. Added v1.1.0. Defined by QSM-FAI v1.1.0 §4.3.

fc_id.description: FiduciaryContext.id this escalation is bound to.

tenure_entry_ref.description: References the TENURE entry (entry_type: escalation) that generated this Outbox entry (EO-01).

reason.description: One of the Escalation Taxonomy values in QSM-FAI §4.2, or an implementation-declared extension — implementations using an extension SHOULD relax this enum accordingly.

status.description: EO-02. A resolved entry MUST NOT be deleted (EO-03) — resolution is a status change.
